name: account-layout-demo
description: Self-contained, no-validator demo of the on-chain account model. Walks every account type the engine defines (Market, OrderBook, Position, Oracle, Vault, …) and reports the byte-precise layout: discriminator tag, size, version. Compares the flat-array OrderBook against the critbit Slab on density (bytes per order capacity). Pure Rust against `openhl-state` constants — no validator, no program deploy, runs in milliseconds. Useful for asking: how much of the Solana 10KB-per-account budget does one market consume? Where does the Slab pack more orders per byte? Which structs are versioned and which are layout-stable?
headline: 11 distinct account types, byte-precise; the critbit Slab packs more orders per byte than the flat-array OrderBook.

steps.explanation: Inspect every on-chain account type via `openhl-state` constants and report discriminator / size / version, plus the OrderBook-vs-Slab density comparison.
